Drivers are configured on the driver screen. | | 6 | Backup driver | Select the vehicle's backup driver. Drivers are configured on the driver screen. | **[3] - VEHICLE** | No. | Field | Notes | | --- | --- | --- | | 7 | Vehicle group | Vehicle group catalog. The system takes the default from the vehicle model. | | 8 | Plate color | Select the color of the licence plate. | | 9 | In-house | The vehicle is in-house. If it is outsourced, **In-house** = false. | | 10 | Owner | Only shown when **In-house** = false. Select the owner of the vehicle. sections.title: Driver history of a vehicle
sections.content:
## Access

**Menu:** Fleet > Vehicles

**Access rights:** Master Data User

Use this screen to view the list of drivers who have driven a vehicle.

## Steps

### Step 1

In the vehicle list, select the vehicle whose driver history you want to view.

![](/uploads/beeca5ff208679f1bace9434.png)

### Step 2

With the vehicle selected, click **Driver history** to view it.

![](/uploads/ff4663535a7941bfcf7f541d.png)

## Result

The driver history is displayed.

![](/uploads/47024d472eb8a2f52bf0ab82.png)

sections.title: Fuel inventory management
sections.content:
## Access

**Menu:** Fleet > Fuel inventory

**Access rights:** Master Data User

Use this screen to view and manage the fuel inventory of each vehicle.

![](/uploads/3eb411ad275dac6a0f1897e7.png)

## Steps

### Step 1

Click **NEW** to create a new fuel inventory record.

![](/uploads/ca728d91629afbd40f5a8761.png)

### Step 2

After you click **NEW**, the system opens the form view. Enter the information to create the new fuel inventory record.

![](/uploads/92e503b5941533a619b523b0.png)

**INFORMATION TO FILL IN**

| No. | Field | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Date | **Required.** Select the date the fuel inventory is recorded. |
| 2 | Vehicle | **Required.** Select the vehicle being recorded. |
| 3 | Driver | When you select the vehicle, the assigned driver is filled in automatically. |
| 4 | Fuel inventory (L) | **Required.** Enter the actual fuel inventory. |

### Step 3

Click **CONFIRM** to save the record and move it to the next state. The result after saving the fuel inventory record:

![](/uploads/b33197dcf416c6e51819ceb7.png)

## Result

The fuel inventory record has been created successfully.

![](/uploads/1169321d0f27372291932f25.png)

sections.title: Odometer management
sections.content:
## Access

**Menu:** Fleet > Odometer readings

**Access rights:** Master Data User

Use this screen to view and manage the odometer readings of each vehicle.

![](/uploads/e379e75e749ac0b1f303a663.png)

## Steps

### Step 1

Click **NEW** to create a new odometer record.

![](/uploads/d98cf9c93554595e1a16ef48.png)

### Step 2

After you click **NEW**, the system opens the form view. Enter the information to create the new odometer record.

![](/uploads/9cda110168ea98c3e48c9498.png)

**INFORMATION TO FILL IN**

| No. | Field | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Date | **Required.** Select the date the odometer reading is recorded. |
| 2 | Vehicle | **Required.** Select the vehicle being recorded. |
| 3 | Driver | When you select the vehicle, the assigned driver is filled in automatically. |
| 4 | Odometer | **Required.** Enter the actual odometer reading. |

### Step 3

Click **CONFIRM** to save the record and move it to the next state. The result after saving the odometer record:

![](/uploads/f1ac6674c680594f509ee848.png)

## Result

The odometer record has been created successfully.

![](/uploads/a658db894202916c00e23300.png)
